misconceptions.description: Writing an aspirational value statement (use AI responsibly) and calling it a policy a teacher can apply
misconceptions.trigger: learner produces a rule with no observable behavior to check
misconceptions.feedback: Rewrite the rule as an observable behavior. State exactly what is permitted, what is not, and what the student must disclose.

misconceptions.description: Basing an AI-use policy on catching violators when detection is unreliable
misconceptions.trigger: learner writes a rule enforced by detecting AI use rather than by disclosure
misconceptions.feedback: When detection is unreliable, base the rule on student disclosure, not surveillance, so it is enforceable and fair.

misconceptions.description: Writing a policy that ignores students with unequal access, so the rule punishes a circumstance rather than a choice
misconceptions.trigger: learner sets a blanket rule with no exception for students lacking home internet or devices
misconceptions.feedback: Add an access path, such as class time or school devices, so the policy does not penalize students for unequal resources.
